adjudicated_statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. Let H=H_{4,6}(P^1) be the Deligne-Mumford stack of pairs (C,gamma) with C a smooth projective connected genus-six curve and gamma:C->P^1 a finite morphism of degree four onto a fixed P^1 (equivalently, the smooth-source open of Mbar_{6,0}(P^1,4)). By FND-0159, H is smooth over k of pure dimension 18 at every point, independently of the ramification profile. Let F be the Casnati-Ekedahl relations bundle in the packet orientation F=ker(Sym^2 E -> gamma_*(omega_{C/P^1}^{otimes 2}))=p_*(I_C(2)), locally free of rank two and degree +9. Let H^bal be the locus where F is isomorphic to O_{P^1}(4) direct-sum O_{P^1}(5). Then H^bal is open in H: on geometric fibres F_t=O(a)+O(9-a) with a<=4, one has h^0(F_t(-5))=5-a, which equals 1 if and only if a=4, so H^bal coincides with the open {h^0<=1} cut out by upper semicontinuity. Hence H^bal is itself smooth of pure dimension 18, reduced and normal; every nonempty connected component has dimension exactly 18. Nonemptiness of H^bal is FND-0154. For h in {0,1,2,3} let H^{comp,h} be the constructible locus of covers admitting a factorization gamma=q o psi through a smooth projective connected curve of genus h with both maps of degree two, and let H^comp be their union. Relative Kontsevich/normal-sheaf dimension plus quasi-finiteness of composition (Steinitz finiteness of intermediate fields of a separable degree-four extension) gives dim H^{comp,h}<=16-2h, in particular dim H^{comp,1}<=14. The hyperelliptic-composed locus H^{comp,0} is disjoint from H^bal (ATT-0088/CLM-0088-2; independently FND-0125, F=O(2)+O(7)). The type-(ii) locus H^ii of FND-0153 inside H^bal is contained in H^{comp,1}, hence dim H^ii<=14. The non-primitive locus H^bal cap H^comp is contained in the union of H^{comp,1}, H^{comp,2}, and H^{comp,3} and therefore has dimension at most 14, i.e. codimension at least four in H^bal. This quantitative bound implies, but is not equivalent to, the following: no connected component of H^bal is contained in H^ii or in the closure of H^ii in H^bal, because every nonempty connected component has dimension 18>14. Thus every such component contains a type-(i) point, the closure of H^ii in H^bal has dimension at most 14, and H^i=H^bal minus H^ii contains a dense open of complement dimension at most 14. In particular balanced type-(i) covers exist and are dense in every connected component of H^bal. The type of a point is PGL_2-invariant; PGL_2 acts with finite reduced stabilizers (subgroups of the finite group Aut(C)), so Hbar^bal=[H^bal/PGL_2] is a smooth Deligne-Mumford stack of pure dimension 15; PGL_2 is connected, so pi_0(Hbar^bal)=pi_0(H^bal), and the non-primitive locus there has dimension at most 11, again of codimension at least four. Consequently the type-(i) hypothesis of FND-0155 is automatic on the universal balanced family and on every connected component of every smooth atlas of H^bal: each connected component of a locally finite-type smooth atlas is a smooth (hence normal integral reduced) k-scheme mapping openly into H^bal with image of dimension 18, therefore not contained in H^ii. The hypothesis is not automatic on an arbitrary reduced locally Noetherian base, which may be a single type-(ii) point; a sufficient criterion is that each connected component have classifying image of dimension at least 15 in H^bal. A redundant independent bound dim H^comp<=17 follows from quasi-finiteness of the discriminant morphism br:H->P^{18} together with FND-0158(a), and already prevents a component of H^bal from lying in H^comp, but does not yield codimension four. Not asserted: irreducibility or the number of connected components of H^bal; closedness of H^ii; existence of balanced non-primitive covers of intermediate genus two or three (if they exist they are type (i) by FND-0153); any Hodge, weight, purity, Tate, Borel-Moore, or RED-0001 conclusion; any component or degree formula over an algebraic stack with inertia (FND-0144); any statement about M_{6,6}, its forgetful map, Aut(C,Gamma), or Gysin maps.
contradiction_resolution: Mandatory first reads: ATT-0112 (claude; claimed_complete geometry lemma on C66-GEO-COMP) states Theorem (A)-(E) and CLM-0112-1 through CLM-0112-8; the contested finding text is the candidate key balanced-type-i-automatic-codim4, which packages (C)+(D) and the automaticity clause of (E) for smooth atlases. REV-0157 (qwen) confirmed all eight claims, recorded that the strongest attack (failure of smoothness/pure dimension 18 of the unrestricted fixed-target stack at highly ramified or composed points) fails because in characteristic zero d(gamma):T_C -> gamma^* T_{P^1} is an injective map of line bundles, N_gamma is torsion of length 2g+2d-2=18, and H^1(N_gamma)=0, so the deformation complex is quasi-isomorphic to N_gamma[0] independently of ramification profile; secondary attacks on openness of H^bal, on the composed-locus bound, and on the redundant discriminant bound also failed. Packet-adjudicated inputs FND-0153, FND-0154, FND-0155, FND-0158, FND-0159, FND-0125, FND-0130, FND-0134, FND-0142, FND-0144 are corroborated and are used within their stated scopes. No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty, and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001 through THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001; it is compatible with THM-0005 (c(6)=5, so n=6 lies outside the published CKgP range and residual geometry on the tetragonal Hurwitz stack remains necessary). Compatible with corroborated FND-0159 (unrestricted fixed-target stack smooth of dimension 18 at every point; that finding explicitly does not assert equidimensionality of the balanced locus or smoothness of the Aut(P^1)-quotient, both of which this finding supplies by openness of the (4,5) splitting type and finite reduced PGL_2-stabilizers). Compatible with FND-0153 (type (i)/(ii) dichotomy on a single balanced geometric fibre; type (ii) factors through a genus-one curve; non-emptiness of type (i) not asserted there). Compatible with FND-0154 (explicit balanced type-(ii) family, so H^bal is nonempty, without claiming a purely composed component). Compatible with FND-0155, whose type-(i) hypothesis this finding discharges on the universal balanced family and on smooth atlases, while FND-0155 still does not determine H_alpha on a purely type-(ii) base. Compatible with FND-0158, which explicitly does not assert ATT-0111/CLM-0111-9 (every type-(ii) point lies on a component meeting type (i)); the present finding proves that conclusion by a pure-dimension comparison (18 versus at most 14), not by a simply-branched deformation. Compatible with FND-0060 (the count b-3=15 is the PGL_2-quotient dimension, matching 18-3). Compatible with FND-0144: automaticity of the type-(i) hypothesis is a statement about geometric points and scheme atlases, not a stack-inertia component formula. Public sources independently support the geometric core and do not contain the campaign-specific FND-0155 packaging. Canning-Larson arXiv:2110.01059 Section 2.3 defines the parametrized Hurwitz scheme H^dagger_{k,g} of finite flat degree-k genus-g covers of a fixed P^1 with no simple-branching hypothesis, and the unparametrized stack as the PGL_2 (equivalently SL_2) quotient; for k=4 it isolates the open non-factoring substack H^{nf}_{4,g} and treats factoring covers (intermediate double covers; monodromy in a conjugate of D_4) as a proper locus. That independently licenses comparing the full unrestricted stack to a proper composed locus and the 18-versus-15 bookkeeping. The same paper's splitting-locus formula (codimension of the (e1,e2) stratum with e1<=e2 is max{0,e2-e1-1}) implies that a rank-two degree-nine bundle of type (4,5) has expected codimension 0, so the balanced type is open, confirming ATT-0112 Lemma 2.2 (h^0(F(-5))=5-a equals 1 iff a=4, and {h^0<=1} is open by upper semicontinuity). Canning-Larson arXiv:2208.02357v2 Lemma 10.6, as excerpted in the packet at SRC-0004, supplies deg(W_f|_C)=4g+12-4f and the relative-canonical convention used to identify L, but is not load-bearing for the dimension comparison. Classical Hurwitz geometry (configuration-space description of simply branched G-covers; Wikipedia Hurwitz space) gives dimension equal to the number of distinct simple branch values, which is 2g+2d-2=18 only for simple branching; ATT-0112 and FND-0159 correctly refuse to infer unrestricted dimension from that count, using instead the ramification-profile-independent normal sheaf. Two wording defects in the candidate text are corrected rather than promoted unchanged: (1) 'equivalently' conflates 'no component of H^bal lies in H^ii' with the quantitative bound dim(H^bal cap H^comp)<=14; the latter implies the former via purity of dimension 18, but the converse fails and the weaker discriminant bound dim<=17 already yields the qualitative conclusion; (2) type (ii) is strictly smaller than the non-primitive locus, since FND-0153 records that a balanced cover factoring through genus two or three, if it exists, must be type (i). Residual limitations are scope, not contradictions: the type-(i) hypothesis remains non-automatic on a base swallowed by the dimension-at-most-14 type-(ii) locus; irreducibility of H^bal is not claimed; FND-0152 induction and S_6 monodromy are consequences of FND-0155 once type (i) is present, not part of this finding's geometric core.

not_covered: arbitrary reduced bases whose classifying image has dimension at most 14, including a single type-(ii) point
irreducibility or the number of connected components of H^bal
existence of balanced composed covers of intermediate genus two or three
Hodge, weight, purity, Tate, Borel-Moore, or RED-0001 conclusions
any image, closure, purity, Gysin, or Aut(C,Gamma) statement in M_{6,6}
